city.scenario: Synthetic dense city; disasters off and automatic investment off. Not a starter or long-term economic calibration.

runs.test: Dense-city close view and streamed accepted music together
runs.economicObservation: By month 28, excess commercial zoning went vacant under unchanged game rules. This is not a performance crash or an economically stable all-policy scenario.

runs.test: Music mute and resume while city is paused
runs.result: Audio resumes while the paused static city does not keep drawing.

limits: Bounded runs only, not an endurance test or direct power/thermal measurement.
Pure monthly calculation improved about 4.4x in the measured 20% fixture. No claim of 10x total energy reduction.
Camera detail and shadow refresh are now budgeted; new render frame counts should not be interpreted as an uncontrolled FPS benchmark.
User Chrome renderer error 5 was reported; its exact OS/GPU failure cause was not independently established.
